dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Work at the Blackcliff Forge has been stopped?

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: It has. The order for us to cease work was sent directly from the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: How could they just stop work at the drop of a hat like that? How will everyone get by? And we need their approval to resume work as well... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Please, help me to investigate the area around the Chasm.
